name: Pac-Man
tagline: Twelve mazes, four ghosts, a pad for your thumb. Scores on the cabinet.
description:
You are the yellow one. Eat every pellet in the maze, grab a power pellet to turn the tables on the ghosts, and do not let them catch you. There are twelve mazes, five lives, and a score that lives in the file you keep.

On a computer it is the arrows (or WASD) and space to pause. On a phone a pad sits under your thumb. Close it and come back: your best score is still there.

Press Invite in the bar above and everyone who opens the link is on the same cabinet. Each of you plays your own maze; the roster shows lives and score. There is no game server and no account.

An unofficial port of mumuy's HTML5 Pac-Man (MIT). The mazes and the ghost AI are theirs. The pad and the shared cabinet are ours. Pac-Man is a trademark of Bandai Namco — this is not affiliated.
